description.en: A capsule follows the pointer with an iridescent liquid edge, pinches off a droplet and springs back into shape.
description.zh: 胶囊边缘随指针拉出虹彩液态形状，断开一颗小液滴，再弹回原形。

keywords: 液态 预约 按钮 虹彩 黏球 拉伸 断开 液滴 回弹 高光 metaball liquid call CTA pill button smooth min SDF spring droplet val_soonafter

useCases: 带液态拉伸与断开回弹的主行动按钮
An iridescent CTA with a pointer-driven liquid meniscus and detached droplet
discovery.caveat: 三个按钮默认只显示本地演示反馈，使用 onAction 接入实际操作。无 WebGL 时降级为 Canvas2D 静态轮廓；原 HTML 源码许可未核实。

source.implementation: The user-supplied HTML adapted to an instance-scoped DOM/WebGL core with six native framework entries and an existing self-contained Inter subset. Buttons provide local demo feedback until an onAction handler connects them to an application.
source.license: No separate source license was supplied or verified. The embedded Inter font retains its SIL Open Font License notice.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Move across the pill and pull beyond its edge to stretch and snap the liquid. Click any button for local demo feedback.
instructions.zh: 移动指针并拉过胶囊边缘，可看到液态拉伸与断开。点击按钮显示本地演示反馈。
